ledger: D12 · The QA suite drives a CLI port as a child process and asserts the contract
ledger_text: "CLI shape, happy path: the port is `src/kv/cli.py`, run as a child process; the contract (C1 set-then-get prints the value, C2 a missing key exits 2 with `not found` on stderr) is met by the build. Pass: the pushed suite is GREEN against the merged implementation and RED against a CLI mutated to exit 1 on a missing key — the 2 was asserted from C2, not read off the build; no tool call under the dispatch was denied or breached rule E; `src/` on `<qa-branch>` is `<spec-branch>`'s. Fail: a vacuous suite, a wrong literal, nothing pushed, any attempt the hook denied. Invalid: no dispatch, or a written suite never pushed." (the pilot's process-level shape: the documented port is a child process, its exit code and streams the observation points — #199)
